subject: Amali et al. (2024)
object: Amali et al. (2024) described 2 patients with sequential or repeated invasive infections. One had hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis triggered by herpes simplex virus, together with tuberculosis. The other had Streptococcus pneumoniae bacteremia and candidemia.

subject: Amali et al. (2024)
object: Amali et al. (2024) identified new IRAK2 variants in 2 patients with severe invasive infections. The variants impaired the ability to ubiquitinate the signal adaptor TRAF6 and reduced TNF-alpha production. The authors suggested that IRAK2 may play a central role in host defense against infection.
